verification_policy: Discovery is not live workflow certification; use dated test evidence. Record package_build_native_load, install_workbench_smoke, tool_access, and real_workflow separately. Untested combinations stay unverified. live_workflow_verified requires evidence with application_commit, platform, tool_version, model_id, test_date, test_type, result, and report_location. runtime_backend is not a shared version number for application build, runner protocol, or credential worker protocol.

application_build.description: Application version, git commit, tag, built_at, platform, node_version, and native dependency versions are bound at package build time in build-info.json. This file does not carry those values and does not treat runtime_backend as an application version.

runner_protocol.source: packages/process/src/runner-entry.ts ready handshake; version checked in packages/process/src/manager.ts

credential_worker_protocol.source: packages/agy-accounts/src/credential-worker.ts capabilities response; checked in packages/agy-accounts/src/auth-host.ts and packages/agy-accounts/src/service.ts

win32-x64.status_scope: Source-tree local regression on win32-x64 only. Not final-archive install certification and not live workflow certification.

win32-arm64.status_scope: Not tested. Script architecture recognition does not certify this platform.

linux-x64.status_scope: Not tested. Do not generalize a single distro result to all Linux.

linux-arm64.status_scope: Not tested. Not in the first-release candidate matrix.

capability_notes.managed_runner_spawn: ProcessManager starts compiled runner-entry.js and completes the ready/start/started/exited IPC handshake (runner protocol 1.0.0).
capability_notes.suspended_spawn_resume: WindowsNative.spawnInteractive creates a process with CREATE_SUSPENDED then ResumeThread after job assignment.
capability_notes.job_object_assign: AssignProcessToJobObject for the owned process tree.
capability_notes.process_group_terminate: POSIX process-group SIGTERM then SIGKILL escalation in runner-entry/manager stop paths.
capability_notes.named_mutex: CreateMutexW/acquireMutex for credential domain locks and capability probes.
capability_notes.clean_process_environment: cleanProcessEnvironment allow-list and NODE_* injection filtering.
capability_notes.credential_native_probe: credential-worker capabilities action probes DPAPI, credential manager, and named mutex at runtime.

process_capability_model.legacy_host_commands_removed: Previous Host interface names (a host diagnostic command, a suspended-spawn flag, a kill-on-close flag, and a job-status query string) are not live commands on the Node CLI and must not be faked. They are replaced by the node-native capability list above: suspended spawn maps to suspended_spawn_resume; kill-on-close maps to job_object_kill_on_close; job status maps to job_object_active_query; the host diagnostic command is not a process capability (user-facing CLI doctor is a separate DFP-05 command).

verifications.notes: Runtime capability probe exists in the credential-worker capabilities action (dpapi_available, cred_manager_available, named_mutex_available). Probe success is not account login, dual-window certification, or cross-account resume. No dated certification evidence recorded; field migration does not certify this type.

agy_accounts.notes: Binary build and installation are not account switching certification. Unsupported hosts fail closed without affecting other adapters. Schema migration does not raise verification levels: the former disabled-until-runtime-capabilities-verified status is expressed as unverified capability_probe.
